svg.title: AIcoach — Landing (verdict first)

text.tspan: Film one down-the-line swing on your phone. AIcoach
names the fault, shows it on your impact frame and
says how sure it is. The why and the drill are one tap
away, and the coach answers your questions after.
For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap who practise at the
range with a phone. Practice tool only — not for competitive rounds.

Your swing clips are private. Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool — not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
